output.subject: Request to match pricing on chicken breast fillets
output.body:
Hi Munster Fresh Foods team,

Thank you for your reliable service. We really value working with you and would like to keep doing so.

We have seen lower pricing on one product and I'm asking if you can match it:

Chicken breast fillets, 2kg: we would need €9.80 per pack, about 45% lower.

This is what the business needs to stay competitive. I'd much prefer to stay with you than move our order.

Could you please reply by {reply_by_date}? I'm happy to talk it through by phone if that's easier.

Kind regards,
Aoife
The Corner Café
